stories.title: Larry Fitzgerald's college career redefined what a wide receiver could look like
stories.summary: Ahead of Fitzgerald's induction into the Pro Football Hall of Fame, take a spin through his Pitt career.

stories.title: How getting fired helped this ex-ball boy reach the Hall of Fame
stories.summary: After firing him, the Vikings rehired Fitzgerald as a ball boy and assigned him to the receivers, a move that shaped his career.

stories.title: Coroner: Grizzlies' Clarke died from drug mixture
stories.summary: Grizzlies forward Brandon Clarke died from "the effects of heroin and cocaine," the Los Angeles County medical examiner's office announced.

stories.title: UConn's Hurley sounds alarm on late additions
stories.summary: UConn coach Dan Hurley says coaches who are taking advantage of recent court rulings to make late additions to their programs are doing more harm than good.

stories.title: Raiders' Cousins, Crosby scuffle at Friday practice
stories.summary: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins and star pass rusher Maxx Crosby got into a scuffle late in practice Friday before their teammates quickly jumped in and separated them.
